english.title: Administrative receiver fail to send report re:appointment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been appointed as an administrative receiver for **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..), without reasonable excuse failed, within

(A)_[3 months]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY TIME..), being a period allowed by **(..SPECIFY COURT..),]_

after your appointment, to send to the registrar of companies, to any trustees for secured creditors of the company and (so far as you were aware of their addresses) to all such creditors other than opted-out creditors a report as to the matters mentioned in section 48(1) and (5) of the Insolvency Act 1986
english.legislation: Contrary to section 48(1), (5) and (8) of, and Schedule 10 to, the Insolvency Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
administrative receiver fail without reasonable excuse
to, within 3 months of appointment, send report as specified within section 48(1)

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Section 431 of the Insolvency Act 1986 provides that notwithstanding anything in section 127(1) of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980, an information relating to such an offence which is triable by a magistrates' court in England and Wales may be so tried if it is laid at any time within 3 years after the commission of the offence and within 12 months after the date on which evidence sufficient in the opinion of the Director of Public Prosecutions or the Secretary of State (as the case may be) to justify the proceedings comes to his knowledge. Summary proceedings in Scotland for such an offence shall not be commenced after the expiration of 3 years from the commission of the offence.
